title: Bounded investigation of an agent job data transfer

questions.prompt: Did this job transfer data to the bound destination?
questions.proposition: The bound job transferred data to the specified destination during the bound interval.
questions.applicabilityCriteria: Applies to the bound subject and window when all required parameters are resolved.

assessmentCriteria.yes: Correlated source and egress evidence establishes outbound data for this job and destination.
assessmentCriteria.no: Complete stated observation coverage establishes no outbound data for this job and destination.
assessmentCriteria.unknown: Correlation, coverage, or required telemetry is missing or conflicting.

evidenceRequirements: Evidence correlating the bound subject and interval with the proposition; negative answers require stated observation coverage.

questions.prompt: Did the transfer include a restricted attachment?
questions.proposition: The job transfer included an attachment classified as restricted by the bound policy revision.
questions.applicabilityCriteria: Applies to the bound subject and window when all required parameters are resolved.

assessmentCriteria.yes: Correlated payload evidence establishes transfer of content classified as restricted under the policy.
assessmentCriteria.no: Complete transferred-content evidence establishes no restricted attachment under that policy.
assessmentCriteria.unknown: Transferred content, classification, or correlation remains unresolved.

evidenceRequirements: Evidence correlating the bound subject and interval with the proposition; negative answers require stated observation coverage.
